bearing.guide.item_vault_storage.text_1: Item Vaults are bulk containers that store much more than a chest does
bearing.guide.item_vault_storage.text_2: There is no inventory screen, so items can't be added or removed by hand
bearing.guide.item_vault_storage.text_3: Fill it with item transport blocks instead, like funnels, chutes or belts...
bearing.guide.item_vault_storage.text_4: ...which can also pull items back out
bearing.guide.item_vault_sizes.text_1: Adjacent vaults combine into a single larger vault that pools their capacity
bearing.guide.item_vault_sizes.text_2: Its square face can measure up to 3 blocks on each side...
bearing.guide.item_vault_sizes.text_3: ...while the length can be as much as 3 times the width
bearing.guide.chute.text_1: Chutes drop items vertically from one inventory into the next one below
bearing.guide.chute.text_2: A Wrench adds a window to a chute
bearing.guide.chute.text_3: Wrap a chute in Industrial Iron Blocks to hide it inside
bearing.guide.chute.text_4: Attach a chute to the flank of another and that section runs diagonally
bearing.guide.chute_upward.text_1: Fit an Encased Fan to either end of a Chute and items can travel upward
bearing.guide.chute_upward.text_2: Engineer's Goggles reveal which way a chute is sending items
bearing.guide.chute_upward.text_3: Since the fan blocks that end, items must be taken out from the side there
bearing.guide.smart_chute.text_1: Think of a Smart Chute as a vertical chute with extra settings
bearing.guide.smart_chute.text_2: The item placed in the filter slot determines exactly what it extracts and passes on
bearing.guide.smart_chute.text_3: Set how many items each pull takes by scrolling on the value panel
bearing.guide.smart_chute.text_4: Redstone power puts a Smart Chute on hold
bearing.guide.brass_funnel.text_1: An Andesite Funnel is limited to one item per pull
bearing.guide.brass_funnel.text_2: A Brass Funnel can take as much as a full stack per pull
bearing.guide.brass_funnel.text_3: Set the exact amount per extraction on its value panel
bearing.guide.brass_funnel.text_4: Put an item into its filter slot to restrict the funnel to that item
bearing.guide.funnel_intro.text_1: Funnels are the simplest tool for getting items into and out of storage
bearing.guide.funnel_direction.text_1: A funnel placed normally draws items from the inventory it's mounted on
bearing.guide.funnel_direction.text_2: Sneak while placing it, and it feeds items in instead
bearing.guide.funnel_direction.text_3: Use a Wrench after placing to flip a funnel's mode
bearing.guide.funnel_direction.text_4: This works the same on nearly any face of a block
bearing.guide.funnel_direction.text_5: Funnels on belts insert or extract depending on which way the belt runs
bearing.guide.funnel_compat.text_1: Several other components accept funnels as well
bearing.guide.funnel_redstone.text_1: A redstone signal pauses a funnel for as long as it's on
bearing.guide.funnel_transfer.text_1: Funnels by themselves cannot transfer items directly between two closed inventories
bearing.guide.funnel_transfer.text_2: Chutes and Smart Chutes handle that task better
bearing.guide.funnel_transfer.text_3: For horizontal moves, run a Mechanical Belt between them
bearing.guide.andesite_tunnel.text_1: Andesite Tunnels sit on top of belts as a cover
bearing.guide.andesite_tunnel.text_2: Whenever belts branch off from the sides of an Andesite Tunnel...
bearing.guide.andesite_tunnel.text_3: ...it peels a single item off each passing stack into the branch
bearing.guide.andesite_tunnel.text_4: The remainder continues down the main belt
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_1: Brass Tunnels sit on top of belts as a cover
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_2: Each open face of a Brass Tunnel gets its own filter slot
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_3: Filtering the entry side rejects any item that fails the filter
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_4: Filtering an exit side routes matching items out that way
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_5: When several exits are valid for an item, the distribution mode settles it
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_6: Brass Tunnels on side-by-side belts link up into a group
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_7: Incoming items get spread over all exits in the linked group
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel.text_8: Feeding items straight into the tunnel works for this as well
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_1: You can configure how a Brass Tunnel distributes items
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_2: 'Split' divides every stack as evenly as possible among open exits
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_3: Exits that are full are ignored
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_4: 'Forced Split' never ignores an exit and waits for it to have space
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_5: 'Round Robin' sends whole stacks to each exit one after another
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_6: Full exits get passed over in this mode as well
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_7: 'Forced Round Robin' passes over none of them
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_8: 'Prefer Nearest' favours the exits nearest to the item's entry point
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_9: With 'Randomize', each whole stack heads to an exit chosen by chance
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_10: Only Brass Tunnels offer the 'Synchronize Inputs' option
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_11: Nothing passes until each tunnel in the group is holding an item
bearing.guide.brass_tunnel_modes.text_12: This keeps every belt in the group moving items at an equal rate
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_1: You pick a Mechanical Arm's inputs and outputs before placing it
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_2: Holding the Arm, right-click a block to select it as a target
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_3: Click a chosen target again to flip it between Input (blue) and Output (yellow)
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_4: Left-click a selected block to deselect it
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_5: After placing, the Arm interacts with the blocks you picked
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_6: Any number of inputs and outputs are allowed, provided they're in range
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_7: Some inventories, however, the Arm can't interact with directly
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm.text_8: Put a Funnel or Depot in between to bridge the gap
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm_filtering.t: Sometimes certain items should only go to certain targets
Mechanical Arms have no filter of their own
But a Brass Funnel used as a target passes its filter on to the Arm
Items that no output would accept are left where they are
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm_modes.text_: If an item has more than one valid output...
Change the mode with the value panel
'Round Robin' cycles through every output that can take items
Outputs with no free space are passed over
'Forced Round Robin' passes over nothing and waits for space instead
'Prefer First Target' gives priority to outputs in the order you selected them
bearing.guide.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: A redstone signal prevents a Mechanical Arm from beginning another cycle
Any cycle already underway is finished first
A brief off-pulse therefore triggers exactly one cycle
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_1: Smart Observers react to many different kinds of events
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_2: It detects items or fluids held in a regular container it faces
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_3: Use the filter slot to react only to specific contents
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_4: A facing block that fits the filter will trigger it too
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_5: Belts, chutes and pipes in front of it can be watched as well...
bearing.guide.smart_observer.text_6: ...plus funnels: a pulse fires whenever one moves an item in or out
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_1: A Threshold Switch measures how much a container currently holds
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_2: Once the contents exceed the upper limit...
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_4: It holds that state until the contents fall to the lower limit
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_5: Wire the output to the supply, here a Smart Chute, to keep the buffer topped up
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_6: Both limits can be set in its interface
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_7: Add a filter to count only matching items
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_8: Tanks and other fluid storage work in a similar way...
bearing.guide.threshold_switch.text_9: ...and, strangely, how far a Rope Pulley's rope is let out
bearing.guide.portable_storage_interface: Storage carried on a moving contraption is hard for automation to reach
This block reaches that storage without you having to halt the contraption
Set a second interface opposite it, 1 or 2 blocks apart
As they pass one another, the interfaces link up
During the link, the fixed interface represents ALL storage on the contraption
You can now feed items in...
After a short time with no transfers, the contraption moves on
While powered by redstone, the fixed interface won't link up
bearing.guide.display_link.text_1: Display Links put live data onto screens and signs
bearing.guide.display_link.text_2: Start with a right-click on the screen that should show the text...
bearing.guide.display_link.text_3: ...and afterwards place it on the block whose data you want
bearing.guide.display_link.text_4: In its menu, pick what data is sent and tweak how it looks
bearing.guide.display_link.text_5: The link now keeps the display updated
bearing.guide.display_link.text_6: Only some blocks are able to provide data
bearing.guide.display_link.text_7: Every compatible block offers its own set of data
bearing.guide.display_link.text_8: One Display Link can drive a variety of display types
bearing.guide.display_link_redstone.head: Display Links and Redstone
bearing.guide.display_link_redstone.text: Redstone power halts a Display Link's updates
Once unpowered, its timer resets and fresh data goes out right away
Powering only the source block doesn't affect the link
bearing.guide.display_board.text_1: Display Boards are signs you can expand to any size
bearing.guide.display_board.text_2: Without a supply of rotation they stay blank
bearing.guide.display_board.text_3: Click with a filled-in Clipboard to show static text
bearing.guide.display_board.text_4: For changing text, feed it from a Display Link
bearing.guide.display_board.text_5: Dye can colour every line separately
bearing.guide.display_board.text_6: Click a line empty-handed to erase it
